name: Slab
description: Posts, topics, users, groups, organization knowledge, and administration through Slab's GraphQL API.
agentUseSummary: Enter a customer-owned Slab team API token, then let agents run selected GraphQL queries or mutations under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: SLAB_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Slab team API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: A Slab team admin copies this from Team settings > Developer. Railway encrypts it and sends it only to api.slab.com.

capabilities.label: Read Slab knowledge
capabilities.description: Run bounded GraphQL query operations against content the Slab Bot can access.

capabilities.label: Manage Slab knowledge
capabilities.description: Run bounded GraphQL mutation operations authorized by the team token and Slab Bot.

allowed.label: Query Slab GraphQL
allowed.description: Run one bounded, non-introspection GraphQL query against the fixed Slab API origin.

approvalRequired.label: Mutate Slab GraphQL
approvalRequired.description: Run one bounded GraphQL mutation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: GraphQL queries run directly; every mutation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected token-authorized Slab query or mutation runs without Relay per-action approval; ownership, fixed origin, bounds, audits, secret non-exposure, Slab Bot access, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts separate query and mutation wrappers and attaches the encrypted Slab token server-side.
Railway mounts separate query and mutation wrappers and attaches the encrypted Slab token server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: A Slab Business or Enterprise team admin must copy the customer-owned API token and ensure Slab Bot can access the intended content.
providerSetup.nextAction: In Slab Team settings > Developer, copy the API token, grant Slab Bot the intended content access, enter the token in Relay Console, and run health, query, denial, and approved or Dangerous-mode mutation checks.

evidence.supports: Slab documents a team-admin-copied API token, GraphQL access governed by Slab Bot visibility, and API/webhook availability only on Business or Enterprise plans.

Slab publishes its current GraphQL schema through an official public GraphOS graph; Railway uses the fixed https://api.slab.com/graphql endpoint and preserves arbitrary current query and mutation documents through bounded wrappers.
Slab documents customer-configured outgoing webhooks separately from API-token GraphQL access; a webhook is not required to connect and execute the API.
